environment: Exact GitHub Actions run 35335042617 for candidate ad14c5aced6cf053c7617dfb03245506e1e9dad5; Playwright Chromium; disposable SQLite/PostgreSQL state; PlayCanvas runtime; 360/390/430 portrait and 1280 desktop evidence.
limitations: Reviewer had prior design context. Browser emulation is not physical-phone testing. Subjective music/SFX listening is not available in this environment; the legacy checker does not encode the separate art/world or audio gate.
prior_context: Reviewer knew the September 17 user rejection and intended replacement progression. Counterexamples target those known failure modes rather than claiming a blind novice study.
user_authority: The current user is the sole final product critic. This internal record cannot establish acceptance.

world_role_stakes.reason: Bellweather, direct protagonist role, disappearance, prison, speech theft and repair objective are rendered before tutorial play.
world_role_stakes.counterexample_attempt: Read the prologue from rendered states only; the role, loss and stakes remained legible.

visible_causality.reason: Lantern release, disappearance, progressive reveal, visible module theft, wrong route, gate opening and deeper-route payoff each change the world.
visible_causality.counterexample_attempt: Checked muted/reduced-motion and final closed, wrong and open gate states; causality did not depend on captions alone.

attachment_pull.reason: The three-light ritual and promise establish a specific relationship before the friends disappear; the ending help signal supplies forward pull.
attachment_pull.counterexample_attempt: Skipped explanatory intent and inspected only the ritual, disappearance and ending beats; the relationship and unresolved rescue remained concrete.

orientation_action.reason: Fresh entry and tutorial present one dominant action at a time: move, look, menu, repair, scan, generate, then explicit Begin Level 1.
orientation_action.counterexample_attempt: Looked for competing required actions at each tutorial state and exercised skip/reload; the required next action remained clear.

hud_readability.reason: World-first HUD remains bounded on phone/desktop and passes enlarged-text checks while keeping goal and action reachable.
hud_readability.counterexample_attempt: Inspected densest phone and 200% states for collapse into a reading page; controls/actions stayed usable.

controls.reason: Direct protagonist movement, touch stick, keyboard, orbit, zoom and recenter pass after persisted save/reload.
controls.counterexample_attempt: Used retained non-text button focus, touch drag, orbit and zoom; movement/camera remained functional without a focus workaround.

meaningful_agency.reason: Chosen context changes model output and world outcome; stale Moon context produces a plausible but wrong route and current Star context changes the command.
meaningful_agency.counterexample_attempt: Deliberately selected stale context and separately made a wrong human prediction under current context; the engine followed supplied context, not the guess.

progression_recovery.reason: Separate guaranteed tutorial success precedes the changed-context mission; wrong route preserves history and recovers through current context without restart.
progression_recovery.counterexample_attempt: Failed the first mission with stale context, then recovered from signs without erasing the failed choice or restarting.

world_continuity.reason: Entry, prologue, tutorial, failure/recovery and payoff stay in the same PlayCanvas story/world continuity with direct control.
world_continuity.counterexample_attempt: Compared tutorial success, wrong route and final payoff; world geometry visibly transitions instead of cutting to a detached results page.

concept_fidelity.reason: The toy causally models context-conditioned next-piece generation with growing input and transparent authored-score/whole-word limitations.
concept_fidelity.counterexample_attempt: Used current Star context with a Moon human prediction; authoritative generation still produced Star, showing prediction is not hidden model input.

fresh_transfer.reason: Level 1 changes the route context after Moon tutorial; stale reuse fails while the current five-point clue supports a different Star solution.
fresh_transfer.counterexample_attempt: Tried the just-practiced Moon solution unchanged; it fails and must be repaired from new context.
